rules.status_rule: Pass only if phase labels, predefined cycle order, registered transitions, and canonical predecessors are excluded from reconstruction inputs.
Pass only if every non-self candidate predecessor is enumerated for every target.
Pass only if all score formulas, weights, normalization rules, unit status, dimension status, and calibration status are explicit.
Pass only if forward and reverse scores are computed and direction classes are assigned from explicit margins.
Pass only if known predecessors are added after ranking and top-1, top-2, reciprocal-rank, tie, and ambiguity metrics are recorded.
Pass only if the directed cycle is reconstructed before comparison with the known phase sequence.
Pass only if deterministic ablations degrade, break, or visibly change reconstruction outcomes.
Pass only if deterministic label permutation leaves reconstruction unchanged.
Pass only if deterministic row shuffle leaves reconstruction unchanged because explicit time sorting is used.
Assign the strongest class only if R1-R9 pass, no unsupported unit assumption is used, and strongest unsupported physical-causality claims are rejected.
